item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc 'tmp_dir=$(mktemp -d)
input_file="$tmp_dir/input.json"
cycle_file="$tmp_dir/cycle.json"
printf '"'%s\\n' '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"build\",\"duration\":3,\"dependsOn\":[\"lint\"]},{\"id\":\"lint\",\"duration\":2},{\"id\":\"test\",\"duration\":4,\"dependsOn\":[\"lint\"]}]}' > \""'$input_file"
printf '"'%s\\n' '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"b\",\"duration\":1,\"dependsOn\":[\"a\"]},{\"id\":\"a\",\"duration\":1,\"dependsOn\":[\"b\"]}]}' > \""'$cycle_file"
bun run src/cli.ts plan "$input_file" > "$tmp_dir/out.json" 2> "$tmp_dir/success.err"
success_status=$?
bun -e '"'const p=JSON.parse(await Bun.file(process.argv[1]).text()); if(JSON.stringify(p)"'!==JSON.stringify({order:["lint","build","test"],layers:[["lint"],["build","test"]],earliest:{lint:{start:0,finish:2},build:{start:2,finish:5},test:{start:2,finish:6}},totalDuration:6,criticalPath:["lint","test"]})) process.exit(1)'"' \""'$tmp_dir/out.json"
json_status=$?
bun run src/cli.ts plan "$cycle_file" > "$tmp_dir/cycle.out" 2> "$tmp_dir/cycle.err"
cycle_status=$?
printf '"'success_status=%s json_status=%s success_stderr_bytes=%s cycle_status=%s cycle_stdout_bytes=%s\\n' \""'$success_status" "$json_status" "$(wc -c < "$tmp_dir/success.err" | tr -d '"' ')\" \""'$cycle_status" "$(wc -c < "$tmp_dir/cycle.out" | tr -d '"' ')\"
printf 'success_output='
cat \""'$tmp_dir/out.json"
printf '"'cycle_stderr='
cat \""'$tmp_dir/cycle.err"
if [ "$success_status" -ne 0 ] || [ "$json_status" -ne 0 ] || [ -s "$tmp_dir/success.err" ] || [ "$cycle_status" -eq 0 ] || [ -s "$tmp_dir/cycle.out" ] || ! grep -Fq '"'a -> b -> a' \""'$tmp_dir/cycle.err"; then exit 1; fi'

Implemented the dependency-free Bun TypeScript CLI in `src/cli.ts`, with full schema validation, deterministic topological ordering and layers, earliest timings, total duration, lexicographic critical-path tie-breaking, and deterministic cycle diagnostics.

Added `README.md`, `package.json`, and meaningful tests in `test/cli.test.ts`.

Verification:
- `bun test`: 5 passed, 0 failed
- End-to-end success output validated exactly as JSON
- Cycle case validated: non-zero exit, empty stdout, deterministic cycle on stderr
